turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40. Who decided on that zero, and why did Owen find out from his phone in the middle of a class?
Don't thank me, answer me. Was anyone going to speak to Owen before that mark went in, or was the gradebook the conversation?
Here is my offer. I will change the zero to 70 percent today if you drop the complaint and we never mention it again.

You're offering me a seventy to make a complaint disappear. I'm writing that down, word for word, and the principal will be reading it this afternoon. Either Owen's essay earned a zero or it didn't, Hale, so which is it?
Nobody has to know. Do we have a deal?
"Nobody has to know." That's going on the pad too. No deal, Hale; the zero comes off because it was wrong, or I'm upstairs in fifteen minutes.
